name: selected-project-read
goal: Keep the currently selected project readable during active runs while refusing a switch to another project

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Opening Game Views reselects the current project. Active or pending agent work should allow that read, while switching to another project stays blocked.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing project-operation ownership tests cover stale identity but not idempotent selection during busy or pending work. Extend the same two-project lifecycle and preserve refusal of cross-project switches.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At cb7432733, the standard two-project ownership flow rejects selecting its own project during active work before the new read assertions can pass.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Return the current project snapshot for idempotent selection while no project switch is opening. All other selections retain the existing busy/pending/opening guard.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
